lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na2Cu6Pd2 (reduced formula NaCu3Pd) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu centers with 10 geometric neighbors, Na centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like arrangement, and Pd centers with 9 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cu 10-vertex polyhedra and corner-sharing between Cu and Na polyhedra.
